definition: To publicly recommend or support a particular cause.
exampleSentence: Environmental groups advocate for stricter conservation laws.
exampleTranslation: Kelompok lingkungan hidup menganjurkan undang-undang konservasi yang lebih ketat.

definition: To distribute resources or duties for a specific purpose.
exampleSentence: The government will allocate additional funds to education.
exampleTranslation: Pemerintah akan mengalokasikan dana tambahan untuk pendidikan.

definition: Based on random choice or personal whim rather than reason.
exampleSentence: The committee made an arbitrary decision without consulting members.
exampleTranslation: Komite membuat keputusan sewenang-wenang tanpa berkonsultasi dengan anggota.

definition: Logical and consistent; easy to understand.
exampleSentence: She presented a coherent argument that convinced the jury.
exampleTranslation: Dia menyajikan argumen yang koheren dan meyakinkan dewan juri.

definition: Including or dealing with all or nearly all aspects.
exampleSentence: The report offers a comprehensive review of recent developments.
exampleTranslation: Laporan tersebut menawarkan tinjauan menyeluruh tentang perkembangan terkini.

definition: To compel or restrict severely.
exampleSentence: Budget cuts will constrain our ability to hire new staff.
exampleTranslation: Pemotongan anggaran akan membatasi kemampuan kita merekrut staf baru.

definition: To arrive at a fact by reasoning from evidence.
exampleSentence: From the clues, the detective was able to deduce the suspect's identity.
exampleTranslation: Dari petunjuk yang ada, detektif berhasil menyimpulkan identitas tersangka.

definition: To make or become smaller or less.
exampleSentence: Her enthusiasm did not diminish despite numerous setbacks.
exampleTranslation: Antusiasmenya tidak berkurang meskipun mengalami berbagai hambatan.

definition: Individually separate and distinct.
exampleSentence: The process is divided into several discrete stages.
exampleTranslation: Proses tersebut dibagi menjadi beberapa tahap yang terpisah.

definition: Based on observation or experience rather than theory.
exampleSentence: There is substantial empirical evidence supporting this hypothesis.
exampleTranslation: Terdapat bukti empiris yang kuat yang mendukung hipotesis ini.

definition: To rise and fall irregularly in number or amount.
exampleSentence: Commodity prices fluctuate depending on global supply and demand.
exampleTranslation: Harga komoditas berfluktuasi tergantung pasokan dan permintaan global.

definition: Implied though not plainly expressed.
exampleSentence: There was an implicit agreement between the two trading partners.
exampleTranslation: Terdapat kesepakatan tersirat antara kedua mitra dagang tersebut.

definition: To succeed in persuading or leading someone to do something.
exampleSentence: Nothing could induce him to abandon his lifelong principles.
exampleTranslation: Tidak ada yang dapat mendorongnya untuk meninggalkan prinsip hidupnya.

definition: Existing in something as a permanent or essential characteristic.
exampleSentence: Stress is an inherent part of high-pressure executive careers.
exampleTranslation: Stres adalah bagian yang melekat pada karier eksekutif bertekanan tinggi.

definition: Belonging naturally; essential.
exampleSentence: Curiosity is an intrinsic element of human nature.
exampleTranslation: Rasa ingin tahu adalah unsur hakiki dari kodrat manusia.

definition: The great size or extent of something.
exampleSentence: Scientists were astonished by the sheer magnitude of the earthquake.
exampleTranslation: Para ilmuwan tercengang oleh besarnya skala gempa bumi tersebut.

definition: A typical example or pattern of something; a model.
exampleSentence: Quantum mechanics created a new paradigm in modern physics.
exampleTranslation: Mekanika kuantum menciptakan paradigma baru dalam fisika modern.

definition: Relating to, measuring, or measured by the quality of something.
exampleSentence: Researchers conducted both qualitative and quantitative assessments.
exampleTranslation: Para peneliti melakukan penilaian kualitatif dan kuantitatif.

definition: To improve something by making small changes.
exampleSentence: Engineers worked diligently to refine the aircraft propulsion system.
exampleTranslation: Para insinyur bekerja keras menyempurnakan sistem propulsi pesawat.

definition: Extremely thorough, exhaustive, or accurate.
exampleSentence: Candidates must undergo rigorous testing before final selection.
exampleTranslation: Para kandidat harus menjalani pengujian yang ketat sebelum seleksi akhir.

definition: To examine or inspect closely and thoroughly.
exampleSentence: Regulators will scrutinize the company's financial transactions.
exampleTranslation: Regulator akan memeriksa dengan cermat transaksi keuangan perusahaan tersebut.

definition: Coming after something in time; following.
exampleSentence: Subsequent investigations revealed severe accounting discrepancies.
exampleTranslation: Investigasi berikutnya mengungkap ketidaksesuaian pembukuan yang parah.

definition: Significant as a cause or basis even if not immediately obvious.
exampleSentence: We must address the underlying causes of economic inequality.
exampleTranslation: Kita harus mengatasi penyebab mendasar dari ketimpangan ekonomi.

definition: Capable of working successfully; feasible.
exampleSentence: Solar energy represents a viable alternative to fossil fuels.
exampleTranslation: Energi surya merupakan alternatif yang layak terhadap bahan bakar fosil.

definition: Found or distributed over a large area or among many people.
exampleSentence: The policy reform received widespread public acclaim.
exampleTranslation: Reformasi kebijakan tersebut mendapat pujian luas dari masyarakat.

definition: Something that deviates from what is standard, normal, or expected.
exampleSentence: The unexpected climate spike was deemed an atmospheric anomaly.
exampleTranslation: Lonjakan iklim yang tak terduga dianggap sebagai sebuah anomali atmosfer.

definition: A person or thing that is the direct opposite of someone or something else.
exampleSentence: His cruel behavior was the antithesis of everything his family stood for.
exampleTranslation: Perilaku kejamnya adalah antitesis dari semua nilai yang dijunjung keluarganya.

definition: A very typical example of a certain person or thing; an original pattern.
exampleSentence: The mythological hero serves as an archetype in worldwide folklore.
exampleTranslation: Pahlawan mitologi berfungsi sebagai arketipe dalam cerita rakyat dunia.

definition: A person or thing that precipitates an event or change.
exampleSentence: The economic reform served as a catalyst for widespread entrepreneurship.
exampleTranslation: Reformasi ekonomi berfungsi sebagai pemicu kewirausahaan yang meluas.

definition: A division or contrast between two things that are represented as being opposed.
exampleSentence: Philosophers frequently debate the dichotomy between mind and matter.
exampleTranslation: Para filsuf sering memperdebatkan dikotomi antara pikiran dan materi.

definition: Deriving ideas, style, or taste from a broad and diverse range of sources.
exampleSentence: Her home features an eclectic mix of antique furniture and modern art.
exampleTranslation: Rumahnya menampilkan perpaduan eklektik perabot antik dan seni modern.

definition: Lasting for a very short time; transitory.
exampleSentence: Fame on social media is often ephemeral and fleeting.
exampleTranslation: Popularitas di media sosial sering kali fana dan berlalu cepat.

definition: Open to more than one interpretation; ambiguous.
exampleSentence: The politician gave an equivocal response when questioned about taxes.
exampleTranslation: Politisi itu memberikan jawaban bermakna ganda saat ditanyai tentang pajak.

definition: To make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse.
exampleSentence: Delaying infrastructure maintenance will only exacerbate traffic congestion.
exampleTranslation: Menunda pemeliharaan infrastruktur hanya akan memperparah kemacetan lalu lintas.

definition: To be a typical example of; illustrate by giving an example.
exampleSentence: Her outstanding leadership exemplifies dedication and integrity.
exampleTranslation: Kepemimpinannya yang luar biasa mencontohkan dedikasi dan integritas.

definition: To place close together for contrasting effect.
exampleSentence: The exhibition juxtaposes contemporary street art with classical sculpture.
exampleTranslation: Pameran tersebut menyandingkan seni jalanan kontemporer dengan patung klasik.

definition: Seemingly absurd or self-contradictory.
exampleSentence: It is paradoxical that increased connectivity can lead to profound loneliness.
exampleTranslation: Merupakan hal paradoks bahwa meningkatnya konektivitas dapat memicu kesepian mendalam.

definition: Spreading widely throughout an area or a group of people.
exampleSentence: Digital communication has had a pervasive influence on contemporary society.
exampleTranslation: Komunikasi digital memiliki pengaruh yang meresap luas pada masyarakat kontemporer.

definition: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically rather than theoretically.
exampleSentence: We need a pragmatic approach to resolve this diplomatic dispute.
exampleTranslation: Kita membutuhkan pendekatan pragmatis untuk menyelesaikan sengketa diplomatik ini.

definition: Representing the most perfect or typical example of a quality.

exampleTranslation: Secangkir teh sore hari dipandang luas sebagai kebiasaan khas murni orang Inggris.

definition: Unnecessary, especially through being more than enough.

exampleTranslation: Ringkasan eksekutif yang ringkas menyingkirkan semua istilah teknis yang tidak perlu.

definition: Kept secret, especially because it would not be approved of.

exampleTranslation: Dia melirik jam tangannya secara sembunyi-sembunyi saat pidato panjang berlangsung.

definition: Very weak or slight; insubstantial.

exampleTranslation: Bukti sejarah yang menghubungkan kedua peradaban kuno tersebut masih sangat lemah.

definition: Present, appearing, or found everywhere.

definition: Experienced in the imagination through the feelings or actions of another.

exampleTranslation: Membaca novel petualangan memberinya sensasi eksplorasi secara tidak langsung.

definition: To clear someone of blame or suspicion; prove to be right.
